title: Los Angeles RSO/JCO relocation assistance amounts
requirement: A landlord who terminates a tenancy under the RSO or JCO must pay the tenant the relocation assistance amount set for the tenant's status (eligible or qualified) and length of tenancy within 15 days of serving the written eviction notice.
coverage_conditions: Tenants whose tenancy is terminated under the RSO or the JCO; amount depends on eligible vs qualified status and length of tenancy. Single-family dwellings owned by a natural person with four or fewer units receive one month's rent.

applicability.per_tenancy: Amount depends on tenant status (eligible or qualified) and length of tenancy; single-family dwellings owned by a natural person with four or fewer units receive one month's rent; paid per unit, not per tenant.

exemptions: Relocation offset: a landlord may offset the tenant's accumulated rent against relocation assistance, unless the termination is required by a governmental order to vacate or comply for an unpermitted dwelling.
penalty: A tenant may raise the landlord's failure to provide relocation assistance as an affirmative defense in an action to recover possession; the tenant may file a complaint with LAHD or pursue a private right of action.
citation: Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance (L.A.M.C. §165.00 et seq.)

title: Los Angeles RPO standardized relocation payments for new construction displacement
requirement: A landlord displacing lower income households by demolishing their units for new construction must pay at least the standardized RPO relocation amounts, increased only if the State Housing Crisis Act or the RPO require more.
coverage_conditions: Only low, very low and extremely low income households displaced by demolition of their units for new construction; above low income tenants receive the RSO or JCO amounts.

applicability.per_tenancy: Only low, very low and extremely low income households displaced by demolition for new construction; above low income tenants use the RSO or JCO amounts in Chart A.
